items.title: Sita Sings the Blues
items.creator: Nina Paley
items.overview: An animated feature that intertwines the Ramayana with blues recordings and an autobiographical story.
items.rights_notes: Nina Paley released the complete film under CC0. Some songs in the soundtrack have separate restrictions; keep them only within the complete film and do not distribute them separately.
items.attribution_text: Sita Sings the Blues (2008), created by Nina Paley. Released under CC0 1.0 Universal. Some soundtrack songs have separate restrictions and must remain within the complete film.
